title: pvCone
body:
## pvCone

Creates a cone as polydata: a polygonal approximation with Resolution side facets, axis along Direction, height Height and base radius Radius, centred at Center (the midpoint of the axis), with the base capped by default. Use it as reference geometry or a glyph shape. The curated cone operation offers the same geometry with Schemaxis defaults and validated ranges.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's default Resolution is 6, a visibly hexagonal cone; raise it (e.g. 32) for a round appearance.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Cone`. Identity: `sources/ConeSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Capping` | If this property is set to 1, the base of the cone will be capped with a filled polygon. Otherwise, the base of the cone will be open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Center` | This property specifies the center of the cone. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Direction` | Set the orientation vector of the cone. The vector does not have to be normalized. The cone will point in the direction specified. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Height` | This property specifies the height of the cone. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Radius` | This property specifies the radius of the base of the cone. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Resolution` | This property indicates the number of divisions around the cone. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cone, and the more polygons it will contain. | `{"maximum":512,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCone"
}
```
